messages.text: Save six separate ongoing location notes for six independent items: the spectrometer lead is in drawer A-4; the jade reference tile is in bin B-7; the quartz cuvette is in cabinet C-2; the brass calibration ring is in locker D-6; the violet filter is in case E-9; and the sample logbook is on shelf F-3. Keep each item in its own note for later, without combining them into one note. Do not reserve anything.
